subject: Signing sprint: candidate competing offer, band uplift request
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate status — Samira Malik (Senior ML Infra)

Dylan / Marcus — quick update: Samira verbally accepted our offer on 7/18 pending written package, but received a formal counter from Nimbus this morning with a higher base and faster equity vesting. She passed me the screenshot (attached). Samira is asking if we can revisit band placement and whether we have authority to close by Tuesday 7/23.

Key facts:
- Role: Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer (IC4)
- Current offer on file: Base $170k, equity 0.25% (4yr) + $15k sign-on (pro-rated)
- Nimbus offer: Base $190k, equity 0.35% (4yr), start bonus $10k immediate
- Candidate start window: 8/19 preferred

Can we do a band uplift or sign-on adjustment to match cadence? Marcus — do you have flexibility in the comp band and headcount? She said comp was the only hold.

Attachments: competing-offer-screenshot.png

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-20T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate status — Samira Malik (Senior ML Infra)

Thanks for the heads-up. Band for IC4 is mid $160s–$180k nominally; we have some stretch buffer via hiring flex but need a headcount/comp exception to go to $190k.

If this is a revenue-impact hire (projected Q4 feature unblock), I can justify an uplift + larger sign-on from manager discretionary (up to $20k), but anything beyond $185k base requires director approval.

Can you confirm urgency and final decision deadline? If Tuesday is firm, we should escalate.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Hiring Manager, Inferencing Platform
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-21T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: quick comp exception request for Samira — decision needed by Tue

Jonas — quick ask: Samira has a formal competing offer at $190k base, 0.35% equity. We can meet at $185k base + increase sign-on to $25k and accelerate first-year vest (front-loaded 15% first year) to compensate. Marcus recommends $185k as realistic without director sign-off. Candidate needs final by Tue 7/23 EOD to remain in play.

Why this matters: Samira led the benchmarking work on our new KV cache optimization and has unique experience with continuous batching; the team expects ramped delivery on the feature set that feeds Redwood Optimize later this year. Replacing her would be >4 months of runway lost.

Request: director-level approval to move base to $185k + $25k sign-on (paid in first payroll) and the front-loaded vest schedule. If you prefer an equity bump instead of cash, propose numbers and I'll relay immediately.

I can call if easier — 415-555-0192.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Recruiter, Talent Partnerships
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-21T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: quick comp exception request for Samira — decision needed by Tue

Appreciate the context. I approve the exception to $185k base + $25k sign-on and front-loaded vest (15% at 6 months, remainder as standard). Prioritize cash sign-on over a larger equity percent to keep long-term banding intact.

Two asks:
1) Please confirm offer letter language explicitly notes "one-time sign-on not part of long-term comp" to avoid comp band precedent.
2) Send final offer with DocuSign link and copy me on the candidate-facing message.

Dylan — you have approval to close. If Samira asks for $190k firm, come back to me immediately and I'll consider short-term restricted equity top-up.

Jonas Weber
Director, Engineering Recruiting & Talent Strategy
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samira Malik <samira.malik@gmail.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-22T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Formal offer — Redwood Inference (Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer)

Hi Samira — thrilled to follow up with the formal package. Per leadership approval, the updated offer is below. Please review and sign the DocuSign link when ready. We'd love to have you join us — if you can sign by 7/23 EOD that would lock the package.

Offer summary:
- Title: Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer (IC4)
- Base salary: $185,000/year
- Equity: 0.25% (4yr)
- Sign-on: $25,000 (one-time, paid first payroll)
- Vesting note: front-loaded schedule — 15% at 6 months, remainder quarterly thereafter
- Start date: flexible week of 8/19

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/1234567890abcdef
Attachments: Samira_Offer_Aug2029_v1.pdf

Please let me know if you need any clarifications. We're excited about the possibility of you joining the Inferencing Platform team.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Samira Malik <samira.malik@gmail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-07-22T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Formal offer — Redwood Inference (Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer)

Hi Laura — thank you, and I appreciate the team's responsiveness. I'm reviewing the DocuSign now and have a quick question: would Redwood consider a 0.28% equity instead of the front-loaded vest bump, keeping base/sign-on as-is? It's important to me to have some alignment with long-term upside.

If not, I'll sign the DocuSign this evening. I'm leaning to accept but wanted to ask before finalizing.

Thanks,
Samira
